scope_note: Sampled collection (men-running-shoes) and blog (styling-sneakers) plus PDP. Keyword-demand data blocked (Keyword Planner platform-id unset; no GSC) — intent judged from on-page evidence, exact volumes unverified.

rows.result: Each template has a single dominant intent: PDP = transact, collection = browse/buy, blog = educate. No mixed-purpose pages observed.

Format matches intent: collection pairs a product grid with intro copy + FAQ (commercial intent); blog is a how-to guide (informational). Titles/H1s align to obvious target queries ('men's running shoes', 'how to style sneakers').
rows.next_action: Confirm exact demand once Keyword Planner (platform-id) or GSC is connected; prioritize clusters accordingly.

rows.result: Sampled collection carries ~1,188 words (intro + FAQ), blog ~1,324 words, PDP ~829 words with a 1,591-char product description. No thin content on sampled pages.
rows.next_action: Spot-check the long tail of ~68 blogs for thin/duplicative posts (several read as templated).

rows.result: Primary keyword appears in title, H1, and intro on collection and blog; secondary terms in body and FAQ. No obvious stuffing.
Sampled blog datePublished/dateModified 2025-11-03; catalog shows active 2025 content. No systemic staleness on sampled pages.

Blog Article schema lists author 'SEO .' — a placeholder, not a real named person. No author bios, credentials, or first-hand experience signals. This reads as machine-generated to both readers and E-E-A-T evaluation.
rows.next_action: Replace with real named authors + short bios (e.g. an OFFLIMITS product/design lead); add author schema with a genuine Person and sameAs.
